newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Cabletron, networkers fall.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Cabletron, networkers fall.

text.p: Cabletron Systems Inc's warning of first quarter results failing to meet analysts' estimates drove the computer networker's stock sharply lower before Tuesday's market open, traders said.
In early third market trade, Cabletron tumbled to 35 from last night's closing price of 45-3/4, they said.
Other networking stocks weakened on the news, announced after Monday's market close.
Cabletron said it expects to report first quarter income of about $0.37 per share versus the First Call consensus estimate of $0.50 per share.
